sentences: I measure 25.0 milliliters of the stock solution with a graduated cylinder and pour it into the beaker.

I weigh 2.5 grams of sodium chloride on the analytical balance and transfer it to a clean flask.
I titrate the acid solution with 0.1 M sodium hydroxide until the indicator changes color.
I place the round-bottom flask in the heating mantle and set the temperature to 80 degrees Celsius.
I run a TLC plate in a 3:1 mixture of ethyl acetate and hexanes to monitor the reaction.
I filter the precipitate through a Buchner funnel and wash it with cold distilled water.
I calibrate the pH meter with standard buffer solutions of pH 4, 7, and 10.

I set the rotary evaporator to 40 degrees Celsius and remove the solvent under reduced pressure.
I measure the absorbance of the sample at 450 nanometers using a UV-Vis spectrophotometer.
I add 5 drops of phenolphthalein indicator to the solution before starting the titration.
I recrystallize the crude product from hot ethanol and cool the solution slowly in an ice bath.
I prepare a 0.1 molar solution by diluting 10 milliliters of the stock solution to 100 milliliters.
I clean the glassware with acetone and place it in the drying oven at 120 degrees Celsius.
